cards.name: Terrarumian Cushion Moss
cards.spec_text:
Pendulum Effect: If you control no monsters, or if your opponent controls a monster: You can destroy 1 other “Terrarumian” card you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card, then place 1 “Terrarumian” Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your Pendulum Zone, except “Terrarumian Cushion Moss”. You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Cushion Moss” once per turn.
Monster Effect: If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can add 1 “Terrarumian” monster from your Deck to your hand, except “Terrarumian Cushion Moss”. You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Cushion Moss” once per turn. This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation.

cards.name: Terrarumian Ivy
cards.spec_text:
Pendulum Effect: If your "Terrarumian" monster battles, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step. If you control a “Terrarumian” monster: You can destroy 1 other “Terrarumian” card you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card, then you can Special Summon 1 “Terrarumian” Pendulum Monster from your GY, except “Terrarumian Ivy”. You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Ivy” once per turn.
Monster Effect: If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 “Terrarumian” monster in your GY, except “Terrarumian Ivy”; Special Summon it, but negate its effects.
● Target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; negate its effects.
You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Ivy” once per turn. This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation.
